{{item infobox | value = 20 {{gold}} | campaign = [[Eye of the North]] | collector = [[Roall]]
[[Nicholas the Traveler]] | commonsalvage = 4-5 [[Bone]]s | render = [[File:Trophy Fangs.jpg|120px]] }} [[Skelk Claw]]s are trophies dropped by [[Skelk]] in Eye of the North. {{TOCright}} ==Acquisition== * [[Eye of the North]] **[[Tarnished Coast]] ***[[Kaykitt Hidemender]] ***[[Skelk Afflictor]] ***[[Skelk Reaper]] ***[[Skelk Scourger]] {{ongoing item research}} ===Farming=== All Skelk in Tarnished Coast [[attack]] at [[melee]] [[range]], so skills that deal [[area of effect]] or [[point blank area of effect]] damage are effective against them. ====[[Verdant Cascades]]==== [[File:Skelk-Farm-Route.jpg|thumb|Farming Skelk Claws in Verdant Cascades]] Start from [[Umbral Grotto]] and go east-southeast. Once you get past the northern big mountain, venture north but do not cross the river. Instead, work your way back closing a circle. Most Skelk groups contain three to four foes, with those outside the suggested route having up to six foes and therefore not suggested for solo farming. Additional Skelk groups can be found to the southwest, but are attacked by neighbouring [[Quetzal]] as soon as the player enters [[compass]] range. Each run usually yields 2-7 Skelk Claws. ==Collectors== {{:Roall/Collector}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|20th July 2009 and 17th September 2012|Verdant Cascades|3 [[Skelk Claw]]s}} ==Trivia== * [[Nicholas the Traveler]] [[Nicholas the Traveler/Dialogue|explained]] that Skelk Claws are useful for fashioning a digging tool.
